name: mirage
text: Thanks, that narrows it down. I haven't proven the cause yet, so treat this as my leading theory. The phone hides a bet when the odds behind its fair price get too old. Right now GitHub's list is made of fair prices with a median age of about 3.7 minutes and some up to 8.5. A bet can age past the cutoff and hide until the next scan refreshes it, and it then comes back at the same price. That fits what you describe, and the Pinnacle feed has been silent for hours, which probably slows the refresh. The other suspect is the 15-second recheck on the phone. I'm adding a log of why each bet is hidden to the next build, so I can say for certain which one it is. I haven't touched the cutoff itself because loosening it would show you older prices. If you'd rather keep bets visible a bit longer, tell me and I'll do that.
